text: Many that live deserve death. And some that die deserve life. Can you give it to them? Then do not be too eager to deal out death in judgement. For even the very wise cannot see all ends.
author: Gandalf (The Fellowship of the Ring)

text: It ain't about how hard you hit. It's about how hard you can get hit and keep moving forward; how much you can take and keep moving forward. That's how winning is done!
author: Rocky Balboa (2006)

text: All right, I've been thinking, when life gives you lemons, don't make lemonade! Make life take the lemons back! Get mad! I don't want your damn lemons! What am I supposed to do with these? Demand to see life's manager! Make life rue the day it thought it could give Cave Johnson lemons! Do you know who I am? I'm the man whose gonna burn your house down - with the lemons!
author: Cave Johnson (Portal 2)

text: Why do we fall, sir? So we can learn to pick ourselves up.
author: Alfred (Batman Begins)

text: Beneath this mask there is more than flesh. Beneath this mask there is an idea... and ideas are bulletproof. People shouldn't be afraid of their government. Governments should be afraid of their people.
author: V (V for Vendetta)
